plan_id.description: Key of the row and name of the file.

ordinal.description: Display only (for example PLAN-03); never addressed.

status.description: Live: staged (launchability is derived, never a status), running (the plan was started), pausing and paused (the operator paused the plan), handed_back (the plan ended handed_back; the epic's landing reconciliation observes its pull request: merged -> merged, closed -> abandoned), parked. terminal.shipped: merged, completed (plan outcome no_change; this row status completed is not the plan terminal completed, whose mapping to the row statuses model-work/08, Git-Distributed Epic Ledger, states once). terminal.closed_unshipped: returned (re-stageable only as a new row), cancelled (plan outcome cancelled), abandoned (a pull request closed after hand-back, the plan outcome aborted, and the plan outcome abandoned), superseded, split, retired, transferred, resolved.

held.description: Set when the server could not start the row (row_unknown, row_not_launchable, spec_unreadable), a task serving it closed lost (role_undefined, class_mismatch, role_unqualified, role_unavailable, attempts_spent), or a row it depends on ended without landing (prerequisite_ended); shown as a hold of kind held with its acts (state-catalogue/01, Holds and Their Acts); epic.next-work skips a held row until the effective role set changes or the operator acts on the epic, which clears it. null otherwise.

spec_section.description: Anchor of the row's section in spec.md (identifiers.adoc, epic specification section anchor).

done_when.description: The row's observable completion criterion, as staged; a required source claim of the plan the row starts (phase-workflows/01, The Intent Record).

regrounded_at_sha.description: Commit the row's specification was last re-grounded against; null when never re-grounded.

reground_verdict.description: The last verdict of the re-grounding task (role reground, epic.reground, one task over every staged row whose spec predates HEAD); a row whose verdict is stale is not launched until its spec section is re-submitted, which clears this field. null when never re-grounded.

verdict.description: stale iff at least one claim is stale.

follow_up.description: Set when a re-planning of a plan of this epic staged the row (Phase Workflows Specification, Dynamic Re-Planning): the plan whose re-planning staged it, its follow-up record, and for a split the preserved ref the started plan's branch begins from, rebased onto the base at execute.worktree-init.

message_id.description: The intake_confirmed message the disposition answers.

started_at.description: Set by the start.create-scope transaction of the bootstrap of the plan started for the row (its source epic_row), by the epic itself or by the operator's Next plan, which sets the row running under the epic lock after the plan scope is written (or startup recovery from the plan's origin.epic_id, store-schemas/01, Transaction Journal, Writes outside the scope); null before.

updated_at.description: The row's last write; what the row waits for is shown since this time.
